peopleAlsoAsk.question: What are the disadvantages of cryopreservation?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet:
Disadvantages of cryopreservation

 One of the major disadvantages of this technique is that ice crystals can form inside the cells thereby causing cell damage. The use of unsuitable cryoprotectants also affects cell viability. Water migration can cause extracellular ice formation and cellular dehydration.
